changelog:
Initial release of memory-auto-sync:

- Automatically syncs all user-assistant conversations to daily Markdown files in real time.
- Uses only Node.js native APIs—no third-party dependencies required.
- Minimal logic: file write only, ensuring stability and zero errors.
- Fully compatible with all OpenClaw versions, preventing API compatibility issues.
- Maintains identical file formats with previous manual memory files for seamless integration.
summary: Automatically records and saves all user-assistant conversations daily as Markdown files with zero dependencies and full OpenClaw compatibility.
